notes: Large runtime binaries and model payloads are intentionally not committed to Git.
The application prepends a staged runtime/bin directory to its child-process PATH.
Development builds may fall back to binaries already available on the system PATH.
The three NCNN runtime archives are pinned and audited in runtime/sources.json; their MIT notices must ship with the staged runtime.
FFmpeg and ffprobe remain blocked from redistribution until an audited LGPL-compatible Windows build and corresponding source/build information are staged.
